name: Protagonist
source:
A first year high school student who is lively and honest.
She thinks everyone around her is important and has a kind heart, but she has a meddlesome side.
She loves books and is part of the library committee.
She really treasures the 'Little Red Riding Hood' picture book she received from her grandmother.
No default name.
